nodes.label: Never trust webhook payload for money (re-fetch)

nodes.label: Gemini model names from env (pinned)
nodes.rationale: -latest aliases returned 503 high demand; pin versions for the demo.

nodes.label: Claimant message delimited and capped at 2000 chars
nodes.norm_label: claimant message delimited and capped at 2000 chars
nodes.rationale: Treat claimant text as data, not instructions.

nodes.label: External calls through lib/ wrappers
nodes.rationale: So services can be mocked and swapped (e.g. Gemini -> another model).

nodes.label: packetFor packet sizing
nodes.rationale: min(DEFAULT, MAX) in integer cents; pool short -> WAITING_FUNDS, never a partial packet.

nodes.label: Pool-balance guard (remaining minus in-flight payouts)
nodes.rationale: UNCLAIMED stays reserved because PayPal holds the money 30 days.

nodes.label: Graphify token discipline
nodes.rationale: Query the graph before grep/reads to save tokens.

nodes.label: planFifoAllocation
nodes.rationale: Oldest donation with remaining > 0 first; allocations always sum to the payout.

nodes.label: totalScore (weighted signal sum)
nodes.rationale: Score = round(sum weight x signal); integers make thresholds exact.

nodes.label: Render Workflows verification tasks
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 runs verify-claim inline; Phase 2 moves to Workflows without logic change.

nodes.label: Next.js agent rules (read bundled docs, breaking changes)
nodes.norm_label: next.js agent rules (read bundled docs, breaking changes)

nodes.label: decide() decision order
nodes.rationale: Uniqueness 0 rejects first, invalid AI goes to IN_REVIEW, then thresholds 75/50; AI never decides.

nodes.label: Money math in integer cents
nodes.rationale: Avoid floating point USD errors.

nodes.label: Gemini retry policy (2 attempts, backoff, IN_REVIEW)
nodes.norm_label: gemini retry policy (2 attempts, backoff, in_review)
nodes.rationale: Never auto-reject on AI failure; invalid output routes to human review.

nodes.label: FIFO allocation of payouts to donations
nodes.norm_label: fifo allocation of payouts to donations
nodes.rationale: Lets a donor's receipt name the exact claims their money reached.

nodes.label: CLAIM_ID_SALT
nodes.rationale: Rotating it changes every public id; do not rotate after demo data is on-chain.

nodes.norm_label: private claim fields (email, lat, lon, message, photo)
